SafeCampus AI

The most prominent project I've built so far.

SafeCampus AI

AI-Powered Campus Incident Intelligence System
Active Project

SafeCampus AI is a technology-driven campus safety solution designed to help identify, analyze, and manage campus incidents more efficiently. The system focuses on using AI-assisted analysis and structured incident information to support faster awareness, response, and decision-making within a campus environment.

Problem

Campus incidents can be difficult to report, organize, analyze, and respond to efficiently when information is scattered across different channels.

Solution

SafeCampus AI provides a centralized intelligent system for collecting incident information, analyzing reported situations, identifying patterns, and supporting campus authorities with actionable information.
